objective: Reducir la latencia del Worker para ordenes de ChatGPT sin debilitar RBAC ni auditoria: atender receive-dispatch-publish-health antes del ciclo de mirror, usar intervalo fallback de 10 segundos y agregar un trigger runtime inmediato reutilizable que ejecute el pipeline canonico una sola vez. No tocar Produccion.

actions.old:
while [ "$RUNNING" -eq 1 ]; do
    run_cycle
    receive_universal_jobs
    dispatch_universal_jobs
    publish_universal_results
    publish_runtime_health
    run_reporting_pipeline
    [ "$RUNNING" -ne 0 ] || break
    sleep "$LOOP_SECONDS" & wait $! || true
done
actions.new:
while [ "$RUNNING" -eq 1 ]; do
    # ChatGPT jobs are the control plane: consume and execute them before mirror work.
    receive_universal_jobs
    dispatch_universal_jobs
    publish_universal_results
    publish_runtime_health
    run_cycle
    run_reporting_pipeline
    [ "$RUNNING" -ne 0 ] || break
    sleep "$LOOP_SECONDS" & wait $! || true
done

actions.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="${EDARSAHUB_ROOT:-/app}"
DIR="$ROOT/tools/mirror_sync"
PYTHON_BIN="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"
if [ ! -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then
  PYTHON_BIN="$(command -v python3 2>/dev/null || command -v python 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
if [ -z "$PYTHON_BIN" ] || [ ! -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then
  echo "ABORT=WORKER_PYTHON_NOT_EXECUTABLE"
  exit 4
fi

STATE="$ROOT/.git/mirror-sync"
if [ ! -e "$STATE/ENABLED" ] || [ -e "$STATE/STOP" ] || [ -e /tmp/edarsahub-mirror-sync/STOP ]; then
  echo "ABORT=WORKER_NOT_AUTHORIZED"
  exit 90
fi

"$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/universal_job_bridge.py" receive
"$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/universal_job_dispatcher.py"
"$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/universal_job_result_publisher.py"
"$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/runtime_health_publisher.py"
echo "UNIVERSAL_WORKER_TRIGGER=COMPLETE"
